data.long_meaning: Shayla is a modern name of uncertain origin, but it may derive from the Greek name Xylia, meaning 'wood'. Alternatively, it may derive from the Hebrew name Shlomit, meaning 'peace'. In both cases, the name evokes images of strength and resilience, as well as a gentle, pretty disposition. The name Shayla carries the meaning “Gentle, pretty” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Shayla usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, pretty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
